title: Outdoor worktable with a multi-rotor aircraft
visual_facts: Several people stand around a table outdoors beside a chain-link fence.
A large multi-rotor aircraft with exposed wiring and landing legs sits on the table.
A smaller gray multi-rotor aircraft and a handheld controller are also on the table.
An open laptop sits near the front of the table.
Tools and cables are scattered around the equipment.
A dark garment hanging behind the table bears the visible text HKU and ROBOCON.
Parked cars and trees are visible beyond the fence.
spatial_relations: The large aircraft is at the center of the table, between people gathered on both sides.
The laptop is in front of the aircraft near the table's front edge.
The fence runs along the left and rear background.
uncertainties: The aircraft models and intended use are not identifiable from visible markings.
The people's identities and the exact outdoor location are unknown.
